description: Defines the Thunder::Plugin::Probe class and its nested classes for network probing, including WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance, with methods for handling Web requests/responses, socket communication, and probe instance management.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe
classes.description: Main class for network probing, managing instances, broadcasting, and listening for Web-based probe requests.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for the probe.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and manages responses.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Sends out probe requests over the network using UDP datagrams.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a socket data frame.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a probe ping over the network.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over UDP datagram.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a probe request message with optional security signature.
